items.t: North Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.q: What is Deep Cove known for?
faq.a: The waterfront village at the District of North Vancouver's eastern edge on Indian Arm — Panorama Park and Deep Cove Park on the water, the Gallant Avenue village core (one of the District OCP's six Village Centres), and the Baden Powell Trail / Quarry Rock trailhead at Panorama Park.

faq.q: Which schools are in Deep Cove?
faq.a: Cove Cliff Elementary, 1818 Banbury Road (K–7), in the village area, and Seycove Secondary Community School, 1204 Caledonia Avenue (8–12), beside the village; catchments are address-based, so confirm the exact address with SD44.

faq.q: How does transit work from Deep Cove?
faq.a: Local buses connect the village terminus to Phibbs Exchange via Dollarton Highway and Mount Seymour Parkway on TransLink's North & West Vancouver network; since September 7, 2026 the R2 RapidBus runs one-seat from Phibbs Exchange to Metrotown, every 6–7 minutes at peak.

faq.q: What should a Deep Cove buyer check about parking and access?
faq.a: That the village runs on a single road in and out and a managed parking regime: the District endorsed a Parking and Access Implementation Plan in 2015 and brought a further Parking Review implementation plan to Council on April 22, 2024 covering on-street pay, resident and time-limited parking.
